prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a lively rooftop party at night. On the left, a woman in a blue dress stands holding a champagne flute, her posture relaxed as she gazes toward the center. Next to her sits a black cat with bright yellow eyes, calmly observing the scene from a low stool. In the center, a man in a green shirt leans against a railing, pointing enthusiastically at the distant city skyline while balancing a plate of snacks. Beside him, a golden retriever sits patiently, looking up at the man with an expectant expression. To the right, a couple shares a quiet moment; a person in a yellow jacket is handing a slice of pizza to a companion wearing a purple hat. The companion accepts the food with a smile, standing close to the edge of the roof. Above them, string lights stretch across the dark sky, providing a warm glow without realistic shading. The background features simplified geometric buildings in shades of navy and indigo. There is no smoke or fire visible in the scene. The composition remains clean and uncluttered, focusing on the distinct characters and their simple interactions. The woman in the blue dress appears confident, while the man in the green shirt seems animated. The black cat remains still, contrasting with the active humans. The golden retriever adds a touch of warmth to the urban setting. The exchange of pizza highlights the social nature of the gathering. All elements are rendered with bold outlines and solid colors, typical of the style.
